name: Chalet Zur Rose
beschreibung: The Chalet Zur Rose is located in a quiet location on the outskirts of Söll in Tirol. The surrounding area is characterized by meadows and mountain forest, through which a network of marked hiking trails runs. The holiday apartment has a fully equipped kitchen, a living room and two bedrooms. A fireplace in the living room, a private sauna and a covered terrace are among the amenities. The quiet location and the layout of the rooms create an atmosphere focused on privacy. The accommodation offers space for up to four guests and is therefore suitable for couples and small families. The valley station of the gondola lift is within walking distance and allows direct access to the ski area.
